subject: City Hall Menorah Display and Winter Holiday Equity
overview: Medford Bytes host Danielle Balocca shares resident feedback on a controversial menorah display at City Hall and moderates a discussion with local faith and cultural leaders on winter holiday traditions, equity, and community healing.

items.title: Opening Announcements and Community Context
items.summary: Danielle Balocca addresses a recent sexual assault in the Middlesex Fells and introduces upcoming content regarding an anti-Semitic incident at a City Hall holiday celebration.

items.title: Resident Comments on City Hall Menorah Display
items.summary: Residents Shira Cohen-Goldberg and Melanie Raelin express dismay and criticism regarding an inaccurate and exclusionary menorah graphic displayed at the Mayor's holiday event.

items.title: Panel Discussion on Winter Holidays, Faith, and Equity
items.summary: Terry Carter, Rev. Wendy Miller Olapade, and Rev. Bruce Taylor discuss the traditions of Christmas, Kwanzaa, and Unitarian Universalism, reflecting on ways to foster community connection, dialogue, and equity.
